mentions.name: Digest
mentions.description: This service combines the sources you already follow — RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, YouTube, X, newsletters, weather, stocks — into one personal email delivered on your schedule. It now includes AI summaries for incoming newsletters, addressing the challenge of keeping a multi-source digest finite and useful.
mentions.problem: Once many followed sources are combined into a single email, keeping the results finite and useful is a challenge.

mentions.name: Digest
mentions.description: A personalized daily digest that aggregates data from across the web into a single feed, pulling in news, weather, newsletters, social posts, Reddit, YouTube, and more. Its iOS app lets users set preferences once during onboarding; AI then automatically prepares a daily digest delivered each morning via notification, covering meetings, weather, health data, commute insights, and relevant news.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://usedigest.com
 — a personalized daily digest.

It aggregates data from across the web into a single feed, pulling in news, weather, newsletters, social posts, Reddit, YouTube, and more.

I also finally launched my first iOS app that goes a step further. During onboarding, you set your preferences once. From there, AI automatically prepares your daily digest for you. Each morning, you get a notification when it’s ready, with everything relevant for the day ahead: meetings, weather, health data, commute insights, and the news you actually care about.

mentions.name: Digest
mentions.description: This web app generates a personalized newsletter by aggregating data from sources around the web — news, weather, newsletters, social media posts, Reddit, YouTube, and more — into a single daily digest. A newly launched mobile app uses AI to automatically prepare the daily digest based on preferences set during onboarding, sending a morning notification with the day's content such as meetings, weather, health data, commute data, and news.
mentions.audience: individuals who want a personal daily briefing
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on https://usedigest.com

- It's a personalized newsletter for you

- All data aggregated from sources around the web

- News, weather, newsletters, social media posts, reddit, youtube, etc. all appear in your digest.

- Launching a mobile app as well now but this will be slightly different than the web app. It will use AI to automatically prepare your daily digest based on preferences/settings you give it during onboarding.
